title: T-1789 partial: fine wool coat and lazy 1812 startup routing
body:
Charles Nelson’s existing green livery gains a fine wool surface in close views, preserving its cut, rig, animation clips and colors.

The DEV integration exposed an 1812 startup regression: blocked automatic routines bypassed the guarded day router and retained the full town route grid. This revision restores lazy routing for automatic work, conversations and returns. Clear paths walk immediately, blocked paths wait and retry, and explicit visitor requests and jaunts retain full routing and return ownership. Other eras retain their existing routing policy.

Validation for `9453fa44842225bdb9de2c687cf7dca2f8a8211d`:

- All eight local source-gate partitions passed the exact committed tree: 1,313 check executions with original limits, resource guards and complete child cleanup. Normal preflight and remote verification passed.
- The real controller/router regression fails on the previous integration and passes with the fix; it runs through the existing daily-life gate.
- All six fresh published renderer jobs passed their actual final footers: desktop stages 1–15 across five partitions (784 checks including repeated common checks), plus mobile stages 1–15 (739 checks), zero failures or page errors.
- All ten standard memory/still jobs passed unchanged ceilings. 1812 measured 362.78 MiB mobile against 375 MiB and 824.02 MiB desktop against 875 MiB.
- The ordinary moving-frame job first failed on one 1835 frame-time spike. One explicitly authorized failed-job repeat passed every tier/movement row under the unchanged limits. The original failure remains recorded; its cause is unknown and this PR does not claim to fix that spike.
- All current ordinary required checks are green. No limit, tier, asset count, geometry or assertion was weakened.

This partial T-1789 increment keeps native clothing fit and photographic acceptance open. The looser 1812 linen seat is separate draft PR #1933, with its canonical asset build pending. DEV only; no production promotion.
